title.en: Describe the nucleus in terms of Z, N and A

say.en: Chlorine's atomic mass is 35.46 u, not a whole number. The reason lies in the nucleus: not every chlorine atom has the same number of neutrons. In this lesson: Use the atomic mass unit.
Describe the nucleus in terms of Z, N and A.
Distinguish isotopes, isobars and isotones.

body.en: *Atomic masses* are measured in atomic mass units: 1 u is one-twelfth of the mass of a carbon-12 atom, $1.660539\times10^{-27}$ kg. Many elements are mixtures of isotopes, so their average atomic mass is not a whole number; chlorine is 75.4% ³⁵Cl and 24.6% ³⁷Cl, giving 35.47 u.
body.kn: ಪರಮಾಣು ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ ಘಟಕ 1 u = ಕಾರ್ಬನ್-12 ಪರಮಾಣುವಿನ ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿಯ 1/12 = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. ಸಮಸ್ಥಾನಿಗಳ ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಿಂದಾಗಿ ಸರಾಸರಿ ಪರಮಾಣು ದ್ರವ್ಯರಾಶಿ ಪೂರ್ಣಾಂಕವಲ್ಲ.

say.en: A nucleus is written with its mass number A on top and its atomic number Z below.
Z protons and N neutrons, together called nucleons, are packed into the nucleus.
Gold-197 has 79 protons, so it has 197 minus 79, that is 118 neutrons.
Isotopes share Z, isobars share A, and isotones share N.
Nuclear masses are measured in atomic mass units: one twelfth of a carbon-12 atom, equal to 931.5 MeV of energy.
Let us read nuclear notation and picture the protons and neutrons inside.

narration.en: A nucleus has Z protons and N neutrons; the mass number is A = Z + N. Z alone fixes the element. Nuclei with the same Z but different N are isotopes (¹²C and ¹⁴C); the same A but different Z are isobars. The radius is about 1.2 A^(1/3) fm.

say.en: A nucleus has Z protons and N neutrons; the mass number is A equals Z plus N. Z alone fixes the element. Nuclei with the same Z but different N are isotopes (to the power 12C and to the power 14C); the same A but different Z are isobars. The radius is about 1.2 A^(1 over 3) fm.

body.en: The nucleus contains $Z$ *protons* and $N$ neutrons, called nucleons; the mass number is $A = Z + N$. The neutron, discovered by Chadwick in 1932, is neutral and slightly heavier than the proton. Isotopes have the same $Z$, isobars the same $A$, and isotones the same $N$.
body.kn: ನ್ಯೂಕ್ಲಿಯಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ Z ಪ್ರೋಟಾನ್‌ಗಳು ಮತ್ತು N ನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನ್‌ಗಳು; A = Z + N. ಸಮಸ್ಥಾನಿಗಳು: ಒಂದೇ Z; ಸಮಭಾರಿಗಳು: ಒಂದೇ A; ಸಮನ್ಯೂಟ್ರಾನಿಗಳು: ಒಂದೇ N.

say.en: Let us solve this together. Find the number of protons, neutrons and nucleons in to the power 197 79Au.
Z equals 79 protons.
A equals 197 nucleons.
N equals A - Z equals 197 minus 79 equals 118 neutrons.
So the answer is 79 protons, 118 neutrons, 197 nucleons.
